---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a new capability for Timeless Design
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

A clear description of the feature you would like.

## Why is this useful?

How does it serve the project's goal — a quiet, editorial, museum-like
archive? Features that feel like a generic SaaS website will likely be
declined.

## Proposed behavior

What should happen, and where (home, archive, object page, about, navigation…).

## Mockup / sketch

Optional. An image or ASCII sketch is very welcome.

## Alternatives

Anything you considered instead.

## Checklist

- [ ] Works on mobile and desktop
- [ ] Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Adds no unnecessary dependencies
- [ ] Is keyboard accessible
